newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia optimistic about 1996 deficit target.
newsitem.headline: Latvia optimistic about 1996 deficit target.

text.p: The Latvian State treasury said on Saturday that it was optimistic that it would not reach its planned budget deficit target of 40 million lats in 1996.
Latvia set the deficit as part of its agreement with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) after the 1995 deficit rose to 90 million lats due to a crisis in the commercial bank sector.
"All will be well. We expect income to significantly exceed spending in the coming days," Treasury's Dace Brencena told Reuters.
"We see tax income of three to four million lats compared to expenditure of about one million in the remainig days of 1996," she said.
The Treasury said in a statement that by December 28 the deficit was running at 29.40 million lats consisting of 436,010 million lats of income and 483,368 million of spending.
It said total internal debt came to 157,425 million lats, of which 121,131 million was funded by government T-bills.
